show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: The show is an aviation thriller about Nishant, an Air Traffic Controller who saves a passenger flight by breaking protocol but is betrayed and framed by his wife and her lover. Disgraced and broken, Nishant is mysteriously given a second chance to relive the same day. This time, he lets the truth unfold, exposing the real culprits without losing his integrity. Starting afresh as a fighter pilot trainer, Nishant rebuilds his life, purpose, and faith. Watch now!
